sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of carboprost during breastfeeding. However, given the very low concentrations in the maternal bloodstream after typical doses (2 to 3 ng/L), the amounts in milk are likely very low. The infant is also unlikely to absorb the drug from the gastrointestinal tract. If a mother requires carboprost, it does not appear to be a reason to discontinue breastfeeding.
